exposure: history of vaginal delivery or cesarean section
pregnant women without a history of episiotomy
pregnant women with a history of episiotomy
cohort: 110 pregnant women with one or more vaginal deliveries or cesarean sections and 110 primigravidae, all up to 12 weeks pregnant
finding: Pregnant women with a history of vaginal delivery or cesarean section had lower PFMS compared to primiparous women, and episiotomy was associated with lower PFMS.
